content.short: Sorted Wallet is the first and only crypto wallet for feature phones, enabling crypto for everyone.
content.description: Sorted Wallet makes cryptocurrency accessible to users with feature phones or modest smartphones by delivering a simple, secure wallet experience. The platform lets people manage digital assets, send and receive funds, and securely store crypto with just a few taps, without requiring high-end devices. It supports a broad range of networks, including Ethereum, Polygon, Solana, BNB Chain, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, ZKsync, Avalanche, Aptos, Multichain, and ZetaChain, enabling wide cross-chain accessibility for everyday financial empowerment.
